operations.title: The source marked divisor separates the positive node from its seven deck translates
operations.body: For every one of the 28 source-derived four-cycle OFPT terms, the positive sign node lies on none of the seven retained marked hyperplanes, while each of the other seven sign nodes lies on the marked divisor. Incidence depths form four exact term profiles.

operations.title: Four-site qG node–marked-divisor incidence census
operations.body: The checker evaluates all seven source denominator normals for 28 terms at all eight sign nodes, finding positive depth zero in every term and exactly 196 marked nonpositive node occurrences.

operations.title: Benincasa finds source-derived separation of the physical node
operations.body: Entry 1178: in every one of the 28 source OFPT terms, the positive node [1:1:1:1] misses all seven marked infinity hyperplanes, while every other deck node lies on marked support (196 occurrences total, with four retained depth profiles). This is the first source-derived separation of the physical occurrence. Because the total-parity relation couples positive to supported nodes, the next calculation is the labelled localization triangle, not a set-theoretic open restriction.

authority_basis.summary: Record the exact marked-divisor incidence census on the eight four-site nodes.
